headline: Going Commando adds six USA v2.00 matches and 18 PAL matches
summary: Four merged pull requests added six matched functions for USA v2.00 and 18 for PAL, covering menus, timers and a Dobbo door (#454, #456, #457, #458). A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The project's USA v1.01 progress report stayed at 98.99% of code.
highlights: USA v2.00 menu work includes Gorn and Hrugis Cloud (#454). PAL counterparts follow in #457.
A new compiler option supports matching the PAL Dobbo door and shared counter with 50 Hz timing (#458).
Two timed text-page controller matches, one for PAL and one for USA v2.00, were proposed in #460 and had not merged.
A further proposal covers a level 22/23 HUD panel in USA v1.01, USA v2.00 and PAL, plus another PAL function (#461). It remained unmerged.
A SteamOS installation report says Going Commando cannot build because Ninja was not found (#459).
